Commentary.Commentary: Right then, this has been quite a one-sided affair and we hope that the finals will be much more thrilling! Pakistan and Sri Lanka would have used this game as a chance to fine-tune their skills and game plans. The final showdown will take place on 11th September (Sunday) at 7.30 pm IST (2 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Wanindu Hasaranga is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for figures of 4-0-21-3. He says that this is how he tries to enter every game. He claims he is happy with his bowling performance and admits that he has been expensive in the past few matches. Mentions that the plan was to bowl dot balls and put pressure on the batters and that got him the wickets. Ends by saying that they can put up a similar performance in the final as well.

Dasun Shanaka the skipper of Sri Lanka says that he will always accept this kind of a birthday gift. Explains that the different combinations they have in bowling has helped them do well against any batting order. Admits that extras have been a concern for them and in the bowling department the fast bowlers still need to do a bit more. Mentions that he is confident that they will improve and come back better in the final match.

Babar Azam the captain of Pakistan says that they batted well in the Powerplay but couldn't continue the momentum. He praises his bowlers for their performance and says that Hasan Ali filled in for Naseem Shah well. Ends by saying that they need to improve some aspects of their game and come back stronger in the final.
Time for the presentation...

Pathum Nissanka is up for a chat and he says that since three early wickets fell, it gave him the time to play his natural game and take time to settle in. Mentions that although there was extra pace on offer from Pakistan, he was confident about his batting ability. Admits that this knock will help him take the momentum into the final.

The game was lost for Pakistan in the first innings itself as they failed to play out their full quota of overs. Babar Azam and Mohammad Nawaz got off to decent starts but a batting collapse resulted in them just crossing the 120-run mark. The Sri Lankan spinners took 6 wickets and completely dominated proceedings in the first half of the game. Sri Lanka did get off to a circumspect start but had enough quality in their ranks to canter towards a comprehensive win.

Pakistan came out with intent and bowled well to begin proceeding as their opening bowlers extracted pace off the wicket. Mohammad Hasnain and Haris Rauf were outstanding all game picking up two wickets each but it was the spinners that failed to perform. They were unable to emulate the bowling effort of their opponents and conceded runs far too freely. They were once again poor in the field and still have a lot of work to do before the finals. This game would have given them a good opportunity to analyze their weakness and will be hoping to come back stronger.

Sri Lanka got off to a nightmarish start as they lost 2 wickets in the first two overs and the chase suddenly looked really different. Dhananjaya de Silva came in and stuck around for a bit but was dismissed soon after with Sri Lanka reeling at 29 runs for the loss of 3 wickets. Bhanuka Rajapaksa played a counter-attacking cameo and along with Pathum Nissanka put on a 51-run partnership to take their team to a position of safety. The latter scored an unbeaten 55 to take his team home along with the skipper Dasun Shanaka.

This has been a walk in the park for Sri Lanka as they have achieved the target with 3 overs to spare and with 5 wickets in hand! They have chased well once again and are now on a four-match winning streak. Who would have expected that after their opening loss to Afghanistan? Pakistan will know that this game is inconsequential in the context of this tournament but would have liked to keep their winning momentum going.
FOUR! Wanindu Hasaranga finishes things off in style! This is on good length and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga makes room and guides it wide of third man for a boundary. Sri Lanka win by 5 wickets.
Fuller and around off, Wanindu Hasaranga makes room and drills it wide of deep point for a couple of runs. Scores Level!

FOUR! Dropped by the fielder at deep third man. Mohammad Hasnain bowls it back of a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga cuts it uppishly towards the third man and Nawaz in the deep dives forward but misses it and the ball goes for a boundary.

A huge shout for LBW but turned down! This is full and on middle and leg, Pathum Nissanka looks to work it away, but gets beaten and the ball deflects off his pads towards square leg. There is an appeal for LBW but the finger stays down, the batters get a leg bye instead.
Wanindu Hasaranga makes his way out to the middle with just 9 runs needed now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A bit of confusion in the deep but the catch is taken safely. Mohammad Hasnain bowls it fuller and slower this time Dasun Shanaka tries to go big but mistimes it completely and there has been a collision in the deep between Hasan Ali and Iftikhar Ahmed but Hasan Ali pouches the ball and Dasun Shanaka has to depart.
Commentary.Howout: c Hasan Ali b Mohammad Hasnain

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Way into the stands! This is on a hard length and on leg, Dasun Shanaka stays there and swings at it, but he gets a top edge and the pace takes it way over the fine leg fence for a maximum. Sri Lanka need 9 more runs to win.
Mohammad Hasnain (2-0-5-1) comes back into the attack.
Fuller length, on off stump. Pathum Nissanka slogs it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A brilliant yorker, on middle, Pathum Nissanka digs it out to cover. Two dots in a row now.
On a length and on off, Pathum Nissanka blocks it back to the bowler.
A slower one, full and on off, Dasun Shanaka drives it towards cover for a single.

That was short, outside off. Dasun Shanaka tries to work it towards the third man region but didn't connect it and the ball goes through to the keeper. Mohammad Rizwan heard something and he goes for the review. UltraEdge shows that there is no edge and Dasun Shanaka stays on the pitch.
Full and on off, Pathum Nissanka slaps it down to long on where the fielder does well to cut it out. Only a single.
Swing and a miss! Dasun Shanaka tries to go big but misses it. Haris Rauf bowls it fuller outside off but Dasun Shanaka was not able to connect that one.
SIX! Dasun Shanaka is looking to finish off things early. This is full and on full and on middle, in the slot, Dasun Shanaka stays there and smokes it over wide long off fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Sri Lanka is getting closer to the target. That was full, in the middle. Dasun Shanaka works it towards fine leg and the fielder in the deep had no chance to stop that.
BEATEN! This is slower delivery, on a length and on off, straightens after hitting the deck, Dasun Shanaka looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller delivery, on off. Dasun Shanaka plays it straight towards the cover fielder.
This is in the blockhole, on leg, Pathum Nissanka squeezes it towards fine leg for a single.
Dasun Shanaka misses out on the Free Hit! Good comeback by Usman Qadir as he bowls it fuller on off. Dasun Shanaka digs it straight to the bowler.

NO BALL! Fuller around off. Pathum Nissanka pushes it through covers for a single. The batters were prepared to have a quick drink but Usman Qadir has overstepped and will have the bowl the ball again. Sri Lanka have a Free Hit.
Another single as this full delivery is drilled down to long off by Shanaka.
Another beauty by Usman Qadir. That ball was on a fuller length and spun away from Dasun Shanaka. He was beaten completely by the spin.
Flighted, full and outside off, Dasun Shanaka mistimes his drive towards mid on. A dot!
Fifty for Pathum Nissanka. A much-needed fifty for Sri Lanka. That was short around off. Pathum Nissanka pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely tossed up, around middle, Dasun Shanaka looks to sweep it but hits it wiht the toe end of his bat as the ball goes nowehere. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW but turned down.
Fuller length, onto the leg stump. Pathum Nissanka tries to play it towards deep mid-wicket but gets an outside edge and the ball goes towards short third man.
Looped up, full and on off, Dasun Shanaka drives it towards long off for another run.
Short of length, around off. Pathum Nissanka knocks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Pathum Nissanka blocks it out to covers.
Lofted delivery, around the middle stump. Dasun Shanaka knocks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pushed through quicker, on middle, turning away, Pathum Nissanka looks to work it to the leg side, but gets a leading edge towards covers for a quick single.
Another full toss! Pathum Nissanka hits hard down the ground but the fielder at long on certainly stops a boundary.
Shortish, on off, turning away, Pathum Nissanka goes on his back foot and flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.

Oh great delivery! Usman Qadir bowls a beauty. That was full around the middle stump. That ball just spun sharply after pitching. Pathum Nissanka pushes at the ball but is beaten on the outside edge as the ball goes close to the off pole. Mohammad Rizwan collects the ball and does the stumping but he is safe.
Dasun Shanaka the captain of Sri Lanka makes his way out to the middle. It is his birthday today and he will be looking to celebrate it with a win.

OUT! TAKEN! Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to take on Qadir as well, but holes out. This is flighted, full and on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa goes down and tries to slog it away, but he cannot get the required timing and hits it straight up in the air and towards deep mid-wicket, Haris Rauf there runs towards the ball, and takes a good catch. There was absolutely no need for a shot like that at this stage, and Bhanuka Rajapaksa will be kicking himself.
Commentary.Howout: c Haris Rauf b Usman Qadir

Commentary.Commentary: Full toss once again. Pathum Nissanka misses dispatching this one and the ball goes towards long on for a single.

SIX! A freebie and it is sent into the stands. This is juicy full toss, on off, Pathum Nissanka skips down the track and heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Usman Qadir is struggling with his length.
Short of length, on the off pole. Pathum Nissanka goes on the back foot and works it towards short third man for a quick single.
Quicker and flatter, on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Pathum Nissanka knocks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz sees ​​​​​Bhanuka Rajapaksa coming down the track, and pulls his length back a bit, on leg, Bhanuka Rajapaksa tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller one, onto the leg stump. Bhanuka Rajapaksa pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up, full and on off, Pathum Nissanka works it towards long on for a single.

Drinks! Pakistan were on fire picking up two wickets in the first two overs. They sent Dhananjaya de Silva back to the hut for a cheap score too. But, Sri Lanka have stabilised their innings, thanks to the partnership of Pathum Nissanka and Bhanuka Rajapaksa. However, Bhanuka Rajapaksa is lucky to be still out there as Mohammad Rizwan missed an easy stumping chance to give him anohter life. Pakistan know that they need wickets as there are not many runs to play with.
Bowls a googly angling into the legs on a fuller length, Pathum Nissanka tucks this to deep backward square leg for a single.
Bowls this one short and outside off, Pathum Nissanka mistimes his cut towards cover.
This is full and in line with the stumps, Pathum Nissanka clips this towards mid-wicket with soft hands and they run well to complete two runs.
Flights this one full and in line with the stumps, Bhanuka Rajapaksa goes for the sweep and gets a top edge on the bounce to the deep backward square leg fielder.

SIX! Bhanuka Rajapaksa wants to make the most of his extra life! Usman Qadir bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa pulls this deep into the stands at deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Usman Qadir bowls a low full toss outside off, Pathum Nissanka knocks this down to long off for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz serves this one full and into the pads, Pathum Nissanka clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single and keeps strike.
Slower through the air, on off, turning away a bit, Mohammad Nawaz looks to block it out, but gets a leading edge towards point. They cross.
Another single as this full ball is flicked away towards mid-wicket.
Floated, full and on leg, Bhanuka Rajapaksa drills it to the left of the bowler where Nawaz dives but only half-stops it. A single is taken.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa blocks it with his inner half to the leg side.

That is a missed opportunity for Pakistan! Mohammad Nawaz flights this one full and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa charges down the wicket and gets beaten by the turn. the ball goes through to the keeper but Mohammad Rizwan does not hang on to this and the stumping opportunity has been missed. Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets a lifeline and Pakistan will hope this does not prove to be expensive.
Reads the googly this time serves short and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets back in the crease and cuts this to deep point for a single.
Bowls another googly from a shorter length and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa does not get bat on this as well.
SIX! BANG! This has been sent to space! Usman Qadir flights this full and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets on one knee and slogs the ball into the deep mid-wicket boundary for a biggie.
Bowls a googly full and wide outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa feels for this but gets beaten.
This is a bit short and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to cut buts mistimes his shot back into the pitch towards the leg side.
Usman Qadir begins with a flighted delivery full and outside off, Pathum Nissanka taps this into the off side and takes a quick single.
Babar Azam is going with spin from both ends as he introduces Usman Qadir into the attack now.
This is full angled into the pads, Pathum Nissanka clips this towards mid-wicket for single.
This is short as well and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa taps this towards short third man and takes a run.
Floats this one full and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa strokes this towards deep cover and they run well to complete two runs. They go upstairs to check but the batter has made it back in.
Goes back to bowling from over the wicket to the left-hander, this is short and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa stays back and plays this late towards third man for a couple of runs.
Flights this one full and outside off, Pathum Nissanka strokes this towards long off for a run.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa paddles this to fine leg for a single.
We will see some spin now as Mohammad Nawaz comes into the attack.
Bowls this on a good length and gets the ball to nip back into the batter, Pathum Nissanka blocks this to the right of the bowler.

FOUR! This has been placed to perfection! Hasan Ali goes full and in line with the stumps, Pathum Nissanka flicks this between mid-wicket and mid on and the ball races away to the wide long on fence for the second boundary of the over.
Delivers this outside off and on a shorter length, Pathum Nissanka knocks this towards point.
FOUR! This has been dismissed! Hasan Ali goes short and outside off, Pathum Nissanka uses the crease and pulls this towards deep square leg for four runs. Pathum Nissanka is looking good here.
This is outside off on a good length, Pathum Nissanka cuts this straight to point.
Hasan Ali begins the over with a full delivery angled into the stumps, Pathum Nissanka clips this towards mid-wicket.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dhananjaya de Silva has to depart and Haris Rauf strikes! He bowls this at 146 clicks on middle and on a good length, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to work this leg side but gets a leading edge that loops towards mid off. Babar Azam takes the easiest of catches and Sri Lanka are three down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Haris Rauf serves this on a good length and just outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva blocks this back towards the bowler.
FOUR! This has been slapped away! Haris Rauf goes short once again and outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva swats this off his back foot aerially towards the deep mid-wicket for four runs this time.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva pulls this towards deep mid-wicket and some good work by Mohammad Hasnain restricts them to a brace.
This is a touch fuller and outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva strokes this firmly towards mid off.
Haris Rauf bowls this back of a length and outside off, Pathum Nissanka guides it towards cover-point and takes one.
Haris Rauf replaces Mohammad Hasnain. He conceded just one run in his first over, and picked up a wicket.
Goes a touch fuller and outside off, Pathum Nissanka taps the ball towards point with soft hands and rushes across for a quick single. 16 runs from this over.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over! Hasan Ali is been carted around for runs here. He serves this one short and outside off, Pathum Nissanka pulls this towards deep square leg and collects four more runs for himself.
FOUR! This has been put away well! Hasan Ali serves this full and into the pads, Pathum Nissanka times this well as he clips it off his pads and towards deep square leg for a boundary.

On a good length and gets the ball to nip back in sharply into the batter. Hits high on the pads and rolls towards cover. They take a leg bye and there is an appeal but this is clearly going down leg.
Hasan Ali serves this one full and into the pads, Pathum Nissanka misses his flick and the ball goes off the pads to the leg side as the take a leg bye.

FOUR! Fortune favors the brave! Hasan Ali begins with a full delivery wide outside off, Pathum Nissanka swings through the line and gets a thick outside edge over the slips towards third man for four runs.
A yorker at 147 kmph, on middle, Pathum Nissanka does well to put his bat down in time to block it. Not sure, if this is a T20I or a Test match. We are seeing a bowling masterclass from Pakistan.
A touch fuller and outside off at 143 kph, Dhananjaya de Silva strokes this to the right of mid off and takes a quick single.
Mohammad Hasnain bowls this back of a length at 144 clicks and outside the off stump. Dhananjaya de Silva blocks this towards point.
This is brilliant bowling from Mohammad Hasnain! He bowls this on a Test match length, outside off, shaping away, Dhananjaya de Silva looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and on leg, Pathum Nissanka tucks it away towards mid-wicket for a run.

DROPPED! A tough one, but a chance nevertheless. This is on a hard length and on off, Dhananjaya de Silva stays there and tries to pull, but the ball hurries onto him and goes of his upper half towards the bowler aerielly, Mohammad Hasnain is a bit late to react and only gets one hand to hit and drops it. A single is taken as the ball goes towards mid off.
This is on a hard length and outside off, Pathum Nissanka hops up and slaps it straight to cover. End of another successful over for Pakistan. They are right on top here.
Goes fuller and around off, Pathum Nissanka pushes it towards mid off.
On a length and outside off, Dhananjaya de Silva cuts it past point for a single and gets off the mark.
Full and on middle, Dhananjaya de Silva blocks it out.
Dhananjaya de Silva makes his way out the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Pakistan get two wickets in two overs and this time it is Rauf. This is a pacy delivery, short of a length and outside off, Danushka Gunathilaka stays in his crease and tries to cut it wihtout any foot movement. But, he only manages to get an outside edge to the left of the keeper where Mohammad Rizwan dives and takes a brilliant catch. This is not going to be an easy chase for Sri Lanka as another batter goes without trobling the scorers.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Starts with a full delivery, on middle, Danushka Gunathilaka drives it past the bowler towards mid off, and denies for the run.
Haris Rauf will share the attack and will bowl from the other end.
Length again, on off, Pathum Nissanka knocks it to the offf side. A brilliant first over for Pakistan.
This is on a good length and on off, at 150kmph, Pathum Nissanka stays back and defends well.
Shortish again and down the leg, Danushka Gunathilaka misses his flick and the ball deflects off the pad towards short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Short of a length and on middle, Danushka Gunathilaka goes back and blocks it out to the off side.
Danushka Gunathilaka will walk out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Kusal Mendis goes for a golden duck, and that is the perfect start for Pakistan. Mohammad Hasnain bowls this on a hard length and outside off, shaping away with some extra bounce, Kusal Mendis stays there and tries to poke at it, but gets a thick outside edge, and the ball loops up towards the right of first slip where Iftikhar Ahmed moves to that side and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Iftikhar Ahmed b Mohammad Hasnain

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammad Hasnain starts with a good-length delivery, on leg, Pathum Nissanka tucks it towards square leg for a single. Sri Lanka and Nissanka are underway.
